positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Implement contract testing using Pact framework to ensure the client and API provider compatibility using Java and Spring.

Use stubbing approach with Cucumber testing to reduce test runtime up to 3x using Java.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Worked with a team of developers and a UI/UX designer to create a social loyalty platform.

Led and developed the web platform for the merchant and help with developing android user app and backend services.

positions.title: Software Developer Consultant
positions.description:
Convert Agent Center, an application where insurance agents manage policies, claims, billings, and client information, from ColdFusion to Groovy/Grails practicing Agile methodologies.

Implement redesigned Agent Center UX/UI from the bottom up using Javascript, Jquery, HTML5, and Bootstrap.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:

- Technical lead/developer for both front and back-end of an application predicting the cost of shipping goods from origin to destination.
- Mentored year-round interns
